newsitem.title: UK: Ramco shares offered at $17.60 per ADS.
newsitem.headline: Ramco shares offered at $17.60 per ADS.

text.p: Energy services and exploration company Ramco Energy Plc said on Tuesday that its public offering of shares have been offered at $17.60 per American depositary share (ADS).
Ramco said it will receive $77.6 million dollars as a result of the offering, which will be used primarily to buy interests in oil and gas prospects in the former Soviet Union.
The American Depositary Shares (ADS) will be listed on the American Stock Exchange.

"This offering represents a very significant step for Ramco in our continuing efforts to establish a portfolio of high quality projects focused on the Caspian region," said Steve Remp, chairman of Ramco in a statement.
